news.t: New look, pro profiles and stretched resolution
news.b: A glass redesign with a video background, one-click pro profiles (pick resolution, graphics, keys), a live stretched-resolution preview with a no-black-bars launcher, your Apex stats and a Top Predator gauge.

news.t: Movement Lab: catalogue, learning path and trainers
news.b: The catalogue of 280+ techniques (with your own keys), the learning path, legend sheets and quiz, the Superglide Trainer and the rhythm trainers are now in ST1M PORT4L.
One-click bind packs for techniques (tap strafe, scroll jump, superglide) and an overlay showing jump, crouch and the mouse wheel.
